_comment: Locked casting. A voice is auditioned ONCE, then frozen here. Later sessions look this up and do not re-recommend, which is what makes the same character sound the same in episode 12 as in episode 1. Dialect or emphasis changes go in style_directive -- never a different voice.

NARRATOR_KO_M_V2.role: main Korean male narrator, warm storytelling
NARRATOR_KO_M_V2.style_directive: Composed middle-aged Korean male storyteller. Steady low-mid register, calm warmth, natural conversational breathing, a very light smile. Key nouns clear but not hammered. One continuous intonation curve per sentence; close sentence endings softly and definitely. No broadcast-announcer projection, no advertising delivery.

NARRATOR_KO_M_V1.style_directive: Mature Korean male presenter. Comfortable low-mid register, crisp articulation, measured confidence. Quick but never rushed; finish final syllables precisely. Emphasise only key words, no exaggeration.

clone.note: seed-fixed, so the same line regenerates identically

preset_speaker.needs: a speaker name from the vendor list
preset_speaker.note: no seed, no cloning -- do not expect an exact rerun

rules: One character keeps one voice for the whole video, and across episodes.
Never swap a reference wav mid-project.
Clone only from audio you own or have permission to use.
Generate per speaker and join locally rather than forcing many speakers into one call.
Keep the original script text; normalise pronunciation into a separate normalized_text field.
